fact: RFI reports on 1 June 2024 that the education minister, Amadeu Cruz, said about 200 teachers in 40 schools had not entered pupils' marks in SIGE within the legal period, that the ministry's Direcção Nacional da Educação, as pedagogic authority, had sought the entry of the marks and referred the matter to the Inspecção Geral da Educação, which opened an inspection; the withholding of marks was a teachers' protest, and the article does not say which school levels the 40 schools are.
title: Cabo Verde: professores enfrentam processos disciplinares
